name: Dentistry of Sugar Land
reviewSnippets: I have always had extreme anxiety about visiting the dentist, even as an adult. I can’t say that anymore because Dr. George is absolutely wonderful! She is personable and her team is always welcoming and kind. She always makes sure I am doing okay during my visits, she explains everything and is through. I highly recommend!
Thank you Gina! That is so kind! Your feedback means a lot. We’re always happy to have you !
